name: RebootInstances

parameters.help_en: The region to which the cloud phone instance belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud phone
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly restart the instance. Valid values:

true: forcibly restarts the instance. This is equivalent to a typical power-off operation. All cached data that has not been written to the storage device is lost.
false: normally restarts the instance.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制重启。取值范围：

true：强制重启。相当于典型的断电操作，所有未写入存储设备的缓存数据会丢失。
false：正常重启。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force
